title: 第5章 一拳毙命第6章 万无一失
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
此时，周围已经站了不少秦府之人。
但这些人大多都是抱着手在一旁看好戏。
一边是秦府的管家，一边是一个卑贱的婢女，没有人会在这个时候出来说句公道话。
秦洪福突然脖子一缩，他感到背后传来一阵冷意。
猛地回头，看到秦伏天眼神森冷的从后方走了过来。
登时，秦洪福猛地吓了一跳。
秦伏天曾是秦家少主，天赋卓绝，且性子极为暴烈。
常年替秦家征战，杀伐果决。
所以在秦家也很有威望。
“少……少主。”
秦洪福几乎是下意识地出声喊道。
但下一刻，他便是意识到，如今的秦伏天，已经不再是过去那个秦伏天。
一个修为尽废的废物，更是被踢下了少主的位置！
想到这里，秦洪福顿时挺直了身板，脸上刚挤出的笑意，顿时多出了嘲讽的意味。
秦伏天冷漠地看了秦洪福一眼，走到秦青瑶身边，将之扶起：“小瑶，你受委屈了……”
秦青瑶听到秦伏天的话，眼泪更为汹涌。
自从秦伏天丹田破碎，在秦家的地位便是一落千丈，而她作为秦伏天的婢女，更能够感受到其中差距。
这段时间以来，她的确受了很多委屈，但却一直咬牙忍受着。
现在秦伏天一句“你受委屈了”，顿时让她破了防。
安抚了秦青瑶，秦伏天这才将目光投向秦洪福。

秦洪福嘴角翘了翘，他料定秦伏天因为修为尽废，只能忍气吞声，否则以秦伏天的个性，早就直接动手了……
“呵呵，秦伏天。”秦洪福脸上嘲讽笑意更甚，指向秦青瑶：“你这婢女不错，本管家看上了，所以想要和她玩玩。可是，这贱丫头很不识趣呢……”
“我看不如这样……秦伏天，你将这贱丫头送给我，让我好好玩几天。你看如何？”
“如何？”秦伏天冷笑一声，下一秒——
他一步跨出，空中只留下一道残影。
秦洪福甚至尚未反应过来，秦伏天已是一拳轰在他的胸口。
“嘭！”
血肉炸开，在秦洪福的胸口，赫然出现了一个拳头大小的窟窿。
“呜，呜……咕噜……”
秦洪福难以置信地瞪大眼睛，似乎还想说什么。
但他一张嘴，鲜血就从嘴里涌了出来。
下一刻，他便是朝后倒了下去。
“嘭！”
沉闷的落地之声，让周围所有人心头皆是一颤。
“秦伏天，竟然杀了秦洪福？并且是一拳毙命？”
“他不是修为尽废了吗？”
原本看热闹的这些人都是惊疑不已。
疑惑的是秦伏天明明丹田破碎，却还有如此强横的战力。
惊恐的是秦伏天依旧是如此杀伐狠厉，并且和过去相比，似乎要更加冷漠……
对！

冷漠得可怕！
“我们回去！”
秦伏天转过身，抱起秦青瑶，再也没有看那秦洪福一眼。
就好像他刚才不是在杀人，而是做了一件稀松平常的小事。
回到住处。
content_en:
At this time, many people from the Qin Mansion were already standing around.
But most of these people were watching the show with their hands folded.
On one side is the steward of the Qin Mansion, and on the other is a humble maid. No one will come out and say something fair at this time.
Qin Hongfu suddenly shrank his neck and felt a chill coming from behind.
Turning around suddenly, he saw Qin Futian walking from behind with cold eyes.
Suddenly, Qin Hongfu was startled.
Qin Futian was once the young master of the Qin family. He was extremely talented and had an extremely violent temper.
He has been fighting for the Qin family all year round, and he has been decisive in killing.
Therefore, he is also very prestigious in the Qin family.
"Young... Young Master."
Qin Hongfu shouted almost subconsciously.
But the next moment, he realized that the Qin Futian of today was no longer the Qin Futian of the past.
A waste with no cultivation, he was kicked out of the position of young master!
Thinking of this, Qin Hongfu straightened up immediately, and the smile that had just appeared on his face suddenly became more sarcastic.
Qin Futian glanced at Qin Hongfu indifferently, walked to Qin Qingyao, and helped him up: "Xiaoyao, you have been wronged..."
Qin Qingyao burst into tears when she heard Qin Futian's words.
Ever since Qin Futian's dantian was shattered, his status in the Qin family has plummeted, and as Qin Futian's maid, she can feel the difference even more.
She has indeed suffered a lot of grievances during this period of time, but she has been gritting her teeth and enduring it.
Now Qin Futian said "You have been wronged", which immediately broke her guard.
After appeasing Qin Qingyao, Qin Futian turned his attention to Qin Hongfu.
The corners of Qin Hongfu's mouth curled up. He expected that Qin Futian could only swallow his anger because his cultivation was completely useless. Otherwise, with Qin Futian's personality, he would have taken action directly...
"Haha, Qin Futian." The sarcastic smile on Qin Hongfu's face became even more intense, and he pointed at Qin Qingyao: "You are a good maid. I have taken a liking to you, so I want to play with her. However, this bitch is very ignorant..."
"I don't think it's better than this... Qin Futian, give me this bitch and let me have fun for a few days. What do you think?"
"How?" Qin Futian sneered, and the next second——
He took a step forward, leaving only an afterimage in the sky.
Before Qin Hongfu could even react, Qin Futian punched him in the chest.
"Bang!"
The flesh and blood exploded, and a fist-sized hole suddenly appeared in Qin Hongfu's chest.
"Woo, woo...Gulu..."
Qin Hongfu's eyes widened in disbelief, as if he wanted to say something else.
But when he opened his mouth, blood poured out of his mouth.
The next moment, he fell backward.
"Bang!"
The dull sound of landing made everyone around him tremble.
"Qin Futian actually killed Qin Hongfu? And with one punch?"
"Isn't his cultivation completely ruined?"
These people who were originally watching the excitement were all surprised and suspicious.
What is puzzling is that Qin Futian still has such strong fighting power even though his dantian is broken.
What is horrifying is that Qin Futian is still so ruthless in killing, and seems to be more indifferent than before...
Yes!
Terrifyingly indifferent!
"Let's go back!"
Qin Futian turned around, picked up Qin Qingyao, and never looked at Qin Hongfu again.
It was as if he was not killing someone just now, but doing something ordinary and trivial.
Return to your residence.
